title: MCP ListToolsResult (spec 2025-06-18)
description: Self-contained schema for the `tools/list` response envelope, extracted from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/main/schema/2025-06-18/schema.json on 2026-05-14. The original schema declares many top-level definitions via $ref; this file inlines only the bits needed to validate the `ListToolsResult` envelope and per-`Tool` shape produced by idealingua-v1's schema emitter (PR-04 IMPL-MCP).

Tool.description: Definition for a tool the client can call.

ToolSchema.description: JSON-Schema-shaped object describing tool inputs/outputs. The MCP spec mandates `type: object` — see `#/definitions/Tool/properties/inputSchema` in the upstream schema.
